input: Build a LAMMPS data file in the class II PCFF-INTERFACE force field (INTERFACE FF 1.5) for a TPEG-type PCE: 6 isoprenyl-ether PEG side chains of 30 ethylene-oxide units with 18 acrylate units, side-chain density increasing along the backbone (gradient), neutralised with Ca2+. Put the system in a periodic box only slightly larger than the atoms (about 2 Å of empty space on every side).
